title: Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro: Clawback of Paid Bonuses
content:
A paid bonus under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** is clawed back only when trips it counted are later disqualified as fraudulent (a debit taking back the trip's pay with the reason fraudulent trip, posted on the trip) and the disqualification is booked within the bonus clawback lookback of 90 calendar days of the bonus credit. The clawback is the whole bonus when the remaining qualifying trips no longer reach the target, and nothing otherwise; a guarantee top-up is recomputed without the disqualified trips' earnings and the difference is clawed back. A bonus is clawed back at most once.

## Basis questions answered

**What starts a clawback?** Only a fraud disqualification of a trip the bonus counted, shown on the earnings statement as a debit with the reason fraudulent trip on that trip.

**How long after the bonus does this apply?** The disqualification must be booked within 90 calendar days of the bonus credit.

**How much is taken back from a target-based bonus?** All of it, if the qualifying trips that remain no longer reach the target; nothing, if they still reach it. There is no partial clawback of a target-based bonus.

**How much is taken back from a guarantee top-up?** The top-up is recomputed without the disqualified trips' earnings, and the difference between what was paid and the recomputed top-up is clawed back.

**Can a bonus be clawed back twice?** No. At most once.

## Hypothetical cases

| Case | Clawback |
|---|---|
| Quest target 40 trips, 43 counted, 2 later disqualified for fraud within 90 days | Nothing: 41 remaining trips still reach 40 |
| Quest target 40 trips, 41 counted, 2 later disqualified for fraud within 90 days | The whole quest bonus: 39 remaining trips no longer reach 40 |
| Same as the previous row, but the disqualification is booked after the 90 days | Nothing: outside the lookback |
